name: research-project
description: Dynamic research fan-out, per-branch review, aggressive distillation, and a final evidence report.

repoCwd.title: Repository
repoCwd.description: Repository cwd used to create the root Paseo worktree.

baseBranch.title: Base branch
baseBranch.description: Committed ref from which to create the root worktree.

objective.title: Research objective
objective.description: Concrete question or project objective with measurable success evidence.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Paseo provider used by all roles.

model.title: Model
model.description: Provider model used by all roles.

concurrency.title: Parallel branches
concurrency.description: Maximum research branches active at once.

maxIterations.title: Turn budget
maxIterations.description: Global turn limit across root and child flows.

explore.description: Launch the proposed coherent research branches in parallel.

iterate.description: The evidence is still inadequate; launch a new targeted branch set.

distilled.description: A robust complex solution is proven and ready to be reduced to its essential form.

iterate.description: Simplification exposed a real gap; launch only the targeted branches needed to resolve it.

report.description: The minimal robust deliverable is implemented and verified; write the final report.

complete.description: The plain-language evidence report and final deliverable are complete.

review.description: Submit this branch's implementation, results, and evidence for review.

revise.description: The branch has a correctable gap; the message contains concrete revision instructions.

accept.description: The branch's claims are supported by reproducible evidence.

prompts.discover:
Lead this research project in the root worktree:
<objective>
{{ inputs.objective }}
</objective>
Work through simple+bad -> complex+bad -> complex+good -> simple+good.
First build or test the simplest plausible approach and make its failures
concrete. Then propose as many independent, coherent branches as the current
uncertainty requires. Each branch must have a distinct question and precise
implementation or experiment instructions. Commit any shared setup that the
child worktrees must inherit before launching branches.
prompts.candidate_work:
Pursue this branch of the research objective in its own worktree.
<objective>{{ inputs.objective }}</objective>
<branch>{{ inputs.branch }}</branch>
{% if event.event == "revise" %}<review>{{ event.message }}</review>{% endif %}
Implement or run the smallest decisive test, preserve reproducibility, and
report exact evidence and limitations. Commit useful branch changes so the
root lead can inspect or integrate them.
prompts.candidate_review:
Review this research branch without implementing changes.
<objective>{{ inputs.objective }}</objective>
<branch>{{ inputs.branch }}</branch>
<worker_handoff>{{ event.message }}</worker_handoff>
Inspect current artifacts and code. Accept only claims supported by robust,
reproducible evidence; otherwise return one concrete revision memo.
prompts.integrate:
Integrate this completed research round in the root worktree.
<objective>{{ inputs.objective }}</objective>
<branch_results>{{ event.data.results }}</branch_results>
Compare evidence, inspect the listed branch workspaces, and manually integrate
only the strongest necessary changes. Do not merge every branch. Continue
iterating while the approach is complex+bad or the evidence is weak. Move on
only when a robust complex+good solution is demonstrated.
prompts.simplify:
Distill the proven solution into simple+good. Aggressively remove unnecessary
components, duplicated paths, speculative options, and incidental changes.
Prefer the smallest understandable diff from the starting point that keeps
the robust result. Re-run the decisive tests after simplification. Launch a
targeted new research round if simplification invalidates the evidence.
Objective: {{ inputs.objective }}
prompts.report:
Write the final report in the root worktree for a reader who knows nothing
about this workflow. Explain the original question, what was tried, what
failed, what evidence changed the approach, the final simple solution, and
how to reproduce the result. Pull exact current data and add useful tables or
visualizations where they support claims. Keep the report plain-language and
ensure every claim matches the final code and artifacts.
